title: Rory and the Dreamy Blossom Hill
verses:
The sun had dipped down in a blanket of pink,
And Rory walked slow by the lavender brink.
The stars started waking above in the deep,
To welcome the valley to stillness and sleep.

Then Ricky hopped over a silvery stone,
To find a soft trail that was sweet and alone.
And Tilly stepped softly across the cool ground,
Where gentle blue blossoms were scattered around.

High over the ridge Nia drifted in flight,
With wings open wide in the comforting night.
And Psittaco snuggled where sleepy vines grow,
To watch the warm shadows that whispered below.

Then Benny leaned down with a rumble of peace,
And waited for all of the chatter to cease.
He curled in the moss with a satisfied sigh,
Beneath the vast arch of the velvet dark sky.

Close into the center came Rory to rest,
Beside every friend he loved dearly and best.
The petals fell down like a blanket of snow,
And covered the hill in a shimmering glow.

Now Benny and Tilly were dreaming away,
For gone was the bustle and brightness of day.
And Rory closed softly his slumbering eyes,
While lullabies hummed from the starry night skies.
